responsibility: Defines RISC-V inline-assembly register classes and registers, including integer, floating-point, and vector operands, architecture-dependent type support, rejection of registers unavailable under the `e` feature, and reserved-register diagnostics and emission names.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/riscv.rs`, this RISC-V file defines inline `asm!` register classes, aliases, and availability checks such as `not_e`, rather than argument/return psABI classification.
